comparison.objective: Lower a bent tube level into a checking fixture so four legs enter their slots together.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual leveling and simultaneous multi-feature insertion under geometric constraint.
comparison.success_condition: All four legs occupy their slots at once, tube is seated and stable, and hands are clear.
comparison.reason: Simultaneous four-point fixture insertion differs from translating a bearing block across a maintained end-face junction while containing mobile internal elements.
